digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback tracing and candidate instrumentation
propositions: Each concrete candidate model in build_fallback_model must be wrapped to emit exactly one ordered rebar OTel child span with no duplication from instrument_all

Candidate spans must nest beneath the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, carrying provider-qualified model identity, outcome from {returned, raised}, and optional provider usage
Sanitized error text from raised candidates must be redacted through sanitize_diagnostic with no prompt, response, credential, or endpoint exposure
The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must be legible as native attempt raised then prompted attempt returned without changing _pai_structured control flow
Best-effort span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must leave fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off
Base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error or lean-import failure
